author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am prioritizing the automated deployment registry to guarantee that every model version is traceable and reproducible. To keep the schedule realistic, I am accepting that experiment tracking will remain a manual process for the time being. I am willing to continue logging our data exploration and iteration notes by hand in local files. This trade allows us to ship the registry first, which addresses the core issue of verifying which model is actually serving the order suggestions. I do not expect to automate the tracking layer until the registry is stable and the team has stopped overriding suggestions due to version uncertainty. My focus is entirely on the deployment pipeline right now.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts the loss of automated experiment tracking in exchange for shipping the deployment registry first, stating this trade allows them to address the core issue while keeping the schedule realistic.
